task.title: probe-bff-authenticated-live unwrap data envelope
task.summary_zh: probe-bff-authenticated-live.mjs 的 isListEnvelope 把 BFF 回應當 {items, cursor, pageSize, totalCountExact} 直讀，但實際 BFF 統一用 {data: {items, ...}} 外層。導致第二輪 CI 27 個 GET read endpoint 全 200 卻被誤判為 fail。修 probe：(1) 改 validator 為 `j?.data?.items` 或先 unwrap data；(2) 對 /bff/me 等非 list 端點仍走原 validator；(3) 在 evidence markdown 註明這個 envelope 拆解。Verification: 重跑 PR CI 時 auth_smoke step outcome=success。
acceptance: /bff/me 等非 list 端點 validator 不誤判

Write endpoints (POST dev-IDs) check for typed 4xx error envelopes. Evidence markdown includes FE-INT-GATE-A08 envelope note. Verification: node --check syntax clean; no-env exit behavior correct. Ready for Codex review.
